description: Angular component for displaying notifications in the Thingsboard UI, including handling of notification display, navigation, and styling based on notification type and severity.

classes.name: NotificationComponent
classes.description: Angular component for rendering individual notifications with actions and styling.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes notification display properties, sanitizes title and message, and sets button label.

methods.name: markRead
methods.description: Marks the notification as read and emits event.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Handles navigation when notification is clicked, either routing internally or opening external links.

methods.name: alarmColorSeverityBackground
methods.description: Returns background color based on alarm severity.

methods.name: notificationColor
methods.description: Returns color for notification based on type and severity.

methods.name: notificationIconColor
methods.description: Returns icon color based on notification type and severity.
